question: Which of the following country was not a part of 2019 South Asian Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Taiwan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Taiwan** was **not **a part of the 2019 South Asian Games, which were held in** Nepal.**
 
• **Bangladesh, Bhutan, and India **were all part of the 2019 South Asian Games.
 
• The **South Asian Games** is a multi-sport event held **every two years **among athletes from South Asia.
 
• The first South Asian Games were held in **1984**, and the most recent edition, the **13th South Asian Games,** were held in** 2019.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bangladesh** is a country in **South Asia** and was one of the participating countries in the 2019 South Asian Games.

 
 
• It is known for its rich history and culture, as well as for being the **world's eighth-most populous country.**
 
 
 
• **Bhutan** is a **small landlocked country** in South Asia that was also a part of the 2019 South Asian Games.
 
 
• It is known for its stunning natural beauty, including the **Himalayan mountains** and its commitment to **environmental conservation.**
 
 
 
• **India** is the **second-most populous country** in the world and was also a part of the 2019 South Asian Games.
 
 
• It has a **rich history and culture,** and is known for its diverse cuisine, music, and art.
